encodingDesc.p: Raw CATMuS and Medusa Unicode retained separately. Same actual page pixels and segment geometry verified. Interpretation proposed, not a diplomatic ground truth. Ten reused pilot pages retain selected main zones; new pages use native unmasked full images. Detection completeness, reading order, marginalia and diagram structure require visual review. No fabricated word boxes or confidence.

Stable page identifiers follow source scan filenames, not a reconciled manuscript foliation. Visible written numbers differ at several checked leaves (for example scan87r bears88, scan164r bears165). A +1 shift after the uncut83/84 bifolium is a working inference, not an exhaustively verified renumbering. Catalogue msDesc is preserved separately; see ../foliation-review.json. No source file is renamed.

Web derivative. Graphic URI resolves to the tiled viewer, not a standalone bitmap or the archival TIFF. Geometry uses pixels of the full unmasked oriented coordinate PNG, identified with its SHA256 and TIFF-to-coordinate pixel-edge affine in the corresponding page.json. Model input masks are recorded separately. Source readings and zones are unchanged. This document is an index and working data, not a complete scholarly edition.

div.note: Dokončení příběhu z41v o náležité zpovědi. Úvod i popis prostřednictví svatého a přesný sled modliteb mají podstatné mezery; nejsou zde vyplněny ze známé hagiografické předlohy. Prima a kapitula jsou označení liturgické hodinky a klášterního shromáždění, nikoli číslo stránky či kapitoly knihy.

div.note: Rubrika De superbia je přímo čitelná. Následuje exemplum o zdánlivě pokorné činnosti a pýše; mnoho syntaktických vazeb a přesná role opata zůstává nejistá. Slovo albas navrhuji jako bílé oděvy/alby s poznámkou, nikoli jako vlastní jméno. Závěrečné věty nejsou souvisle rozluštěny.
div.p: In monasterio quodam sanctimonialium, iam non multis annis, virgo quaedam degebat, vocata Beatrix, corpore speciosa, mente devota, et in obsequio genetricis Dei fervens. Illa vero [---] luxuriae spiritu [---] et [---] importunius instante, tam vehementer [---] succensa [---] flammam [---] tolerare non posset. Accedens ad altare beatae Virginis [---] oravit: O domina, quanto devotius servivi tibi, ecce claves tuas tibi resigno, quia [---] sustinere non valeo. Positisque super altare clavibus [---].

div.p: [---] secuta est illum. Quae cum misere corrupta esset, post dies paucos abiecit eam. Illa cum non haberet unde viveret, ad claustrum redire erubescens, facta est meretrix, in qua [vita?] dum per [XV] annos [---]. Die quadam in habitu saeculari ad portam venit monasterii. Quae cum dixisset portario, [---] novisti huius oratorii custodem? Respondit aperto nomine: Est [---] bona [---] et sancta [---]; [---] usque ad hunc diem in hoc monasterio [---]. Illa vero hominis notitiam se non intelligens, cum abire vellet, [---] Mariae effigies ei apparens ait: Ego pro XV annos absentiae tuae officium tuum supplevi. Revertere nunc in locum tuum et poenitentiam age, quia nullus hominum novit excessum tuum. In forma siquidem et habitu illius Dei genitrix vices gerebat in custodia. Quae mox ut ingressa est claustrum, [---] Dei virgini gratias agens [---].
